div.ab: Ciricean mundbyrd sie L scll' swa cinges.

[Violation of the] protection of the church shall be 50 shillings, as the king’s.
The mundbyrd of the Church shall be 50 shillings like the king’s.
The [breach of] the Church’s protection is to be 50 shillings like the king’s.
Der Kirche Sonderschutz sei [von seinem Verletzer ihr zu büssen mit] 50 Schll., wie der des Königs.
The Church’s special protection is to be [compensated to it by the one who violates it with] 50 shillings, like the king’s.
